summary: Iteration 87 — Frontend-only verification of 4 QRU Factory fixes: (1) Quality Gates certify-treasure flow, (2) certify auth gating, (3) Media Division Studios panel copy/links, (4) Book cover select no-error regression. ALL FOUR PASS end-to-end against the live PREVIEW backend. Real mutation observed on the certify endpoint (PRD-00223 went Paused 88 → Cleared 95); summary counts updated (Paused 184→183, Cleared 47→48). No AI/Gemini/TTS spend triggered by any tested flow.
critical_code_review_comments: GateDetail (ManufacturingInspection.js) — role gating is correct: SUPER=['Founder & CEO','Administrator'], panel/btn only render when isSuper && treasureFailing && d.subject. Confirmed at runtime that Administrator role sees the Founder sign-off panel and Customer role cannot even reach /inspection.

MediaDivision.js — 'coming soon' wording fully removed. Panel is titled 'Audio & Video — made in the Studios'. All 6 future-* chips are react-router-dom <Link to='/cinema-studio'> and md-open-studios link is present and navigates correctly.

BookManufacturing.js — doSelectCover now uses the single run() wrapper (one reload). No 'Something went wrong' spurious toast observed after selecting a successful AI-art cover on 'The Understanding Tree'. Success toast fires once with the correct copy 'Cover N selected — clean retail edition prepared.' Sonner may render an aria-live duplicate for a11y — that is expected sonner behaviour, not a duplicate emission from the callback.

Pre-existing (out of scope for this iteration): Console hydration warning in BookManufacturing.js line 164 — '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in the book-switcher <select>. Caused by Emergent's dev-time <span x-*> instrumentation being injected inside <option>, not by product code. Harmless in production build but worth noting so it doesn't slip into a real bug later.
test_credentials: Super-admin: demo.admin@qru.com / qru-demo-admin-2026 (Administrator). Customer: demo.student@qru.com / qru-demo-student-2026.
seed_data_creation: Real data mutation: certified PRD-00223 (AI Literacy — Poster) via POST /api/inspection/product/{id}/certify-treasure — this is the actual feature under test, deterministic, and expected. Product moved from Paused (score 88) to Cleared (score 95). Cleared count 47→48, Paused 184→183. No writes triggered outside the certify endpoint; no AI/Gemini/TTS calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 fixes confirmed. When testing the certify flow, wait for auth context to hydrate (~2s after modal open) before asserting certify-treasure-panel visibility — is_visible immediately after opening modal can race the React auth context. Products blocked ONLY by Treasure Standard are plentiful (PRD-00220, 219, 221 still available for retesting after this iteration cleared 00223 and previously 00226). Customer role is blocked at the /inspection route entirely (page never renders inspection-filters), so certify-treasure-btn cannot even theoretically appear for non-super-admin.

detailed_results.1_certify_flow: PASS — /inspection loaded, paused=184 initially. Clicked filter-paused, clicked inspection-row-PRD-00223 (blocked ONLY by 'Treasure Standard™ Compliance (88/90)'). Modal inspection-detail opened, certify-treasure-panel + certify-treasure-btn visible. Click certify-treasure-btn → success toast: 'Certified Treasure Standard™ — cleared to manufacture (score 95).' → inspection-cleared appeared ('Cleared to manufacture — all blocking gates passed.') → closed modal → paused stat went 184 → 183, cleared stat went 47 → 48 → reopened row: still shows inspection-cleared, gate=Cleared, treasure_standard now 100/90.
detailed_results.2_certify_auth_gating: PASS — Logged in as demo.student@qru.com (Customer). /inspection page is blocked at the route level (no inspection-filters, no rows rendered), which is a stricter guarantee than 'button hidden' — the Customer never even sees the inspection UI. Combined with previously curl-verified 403 on POST /api/inspection/product/{id}/certify-treasure for Customer tokens, gating is airtight both server- and client-side.

Toast content: 'Cover 2 selected — clean retail edition prepared.' — success only. NO 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' spurious error toast appeared afterwards. The double-reload regression is fixed.
